segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hey, do you have ten minutes to look at the Northstar renewal? They're pushing for signature by Friday.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Yeah, I can. Is this the one adding the support add-on?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That's right. They want 92 seats, support add-on, and a May 1 go-live for the two new teams. I put the new seat count in the CRM and the pricing sheet yesterday; the billing draft and order form are still on 86 until I touch those after lunch.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Okay. What term are they asking for?

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Twelve months. June 1 through May 31 next year. Procurement asked for net 45, but finance said we can only do net 30 unless they prepay.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: $41,400 annual subscription, plus $3,600 for the add-on. No services fee. I held them to the standard 4% uplift on renewal.

segments.speaker: Colleague
segments.text: Looks reasonable. If you send me the draft by 2:30, I'll check the totals and the invoice language.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. I'll clean up the payment terms and send it over. Thanks.
